svg.aria-label: Scenario 4, results and slides for your advisor, by tomorrow. You ask: My advisor wants results and slides tomorrow. In your session: step 1, /research-master:results-analyst returns verified numbers and figures; it reads EXPERIMENT_LEDGER.md rows with the ACK line and writes a metric block per run, per-seed by per-fold values, mean, sample sd and n; all seeds, all folds and failed runs are included in the accounting; it never massages a number, and calibration and any unflattering metric are reported as found. Then /research-master:science-presenter, audience-facing decks, posters and one-pagers, never skips the brief and never computes a new statistic; a missing number is a request to /results-analyst. Its session contract, in order: step 2, the audience brief, blocking, before any design work: audience and venue (lab meeting, conference, defense, public, other), time limit, language; Tomorrow, quickly, just make it impressive do not waive it. Step 3, the pre-flight source scan: every file the artifact draws from, figures, numbers files, docs, notes, is verified on disk before anything is embedded; a short list is checked directly; a long list is delegated, across the context boundary, to a read-only search agent if the runtime provides one; it never embeds a figure or quotes a number whose source was not just verified; missing or stale, it reports and routes regeneration to the owning lane. Step 4, build a deck, poster or one-pager from the verified source table, then the honesty rail, among its guards: every shown number keeps its uncertainty; simplification may omit, never inflate. Step 5, you present: the role builds what you show, delivered and walked through slide by slide for edits. Footnote, SCIENTIFIC_RULES section 4, reporting rules, no cherry-picking: All seeds and all folds of a protocol are reported; the result is the mean plus or minus sample standard deviation across them, with the per-seed and per-fold values kept in the row. A single best seed or fold is never the result.
svg.title: Scenario 4 — results and slides for your advisor, by tomorrow
svg.desc: You ask results-analyst for verified numbers from the ledger; science-presenter asks the blocking audience brief, runs the pre-flight source scan (a long list may go to a read-only search agent across the context boundary), builds from the verified source table, and you present.
svg.text: Results and slides for your advisor, by tomorrow
Verified numbers → audience brief → pre-flight source scan → build → you present. “Tomorrow” does not waive the brief.
